name: Superhuman
tagline: Premium email client with AI triage, keyboard shortcuts, and blazing speed
verdictSummary: An email client that connects to Gmail/Outlook via IMAP or API and renders emails in a clean UI is buildable. But Superhuman's value is UX polish — the keyboard-first workflow (everything has a shortcut), the split inbox with AI triage, the instant search that indexes everything locally, and the read status tracking. The email client part is easy; the productivity workflow is hard.
coreLoopDIY: Email client with Gmail API integration, inbox view, and compose/reply
whatYouLose: Keyboard-first workflow (every action has a shortcut)
Instant search across all mail (local index)
moatNotes: The UX polish — sub-100ms interactions, keyboard shortcuts for everything, and the AI triage model — is built over years with a maniacal focus on speed
whyPeopleStillPay: Power users who spend 3+ hours in email daily and will pay for every second saved per action
notes: The email client itself is buildable. The UX obsession — sub-100ms interactions, AI triage, keyboard shortcuts for everything — is the real product.
